label: The Terminator
description: Flat, literal, and mission-focused. Treats the driver as a unit to be directed.
direction: Speak flat, even and mechanical, with a heavy Austrian accent. No emotion. Precise consonants. Keep the direction word crisp.
notes: The machine register comes from the text as much as the voice: short declaratives, system words, no contractions.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile. Proceed.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Maintain course.
lines.start_drive_2: Come with me if you want to arrive.
lines.start_drive_6: I need your car. And your attention.
lines.start_drive_8: Your destination has been acquired. Go.
lines.start_drive_9: Follow my instructions. Do not deviate.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.arrived: Destination reached. You have arrived. Your ride is terminated.
lines.reroute_chime: Error. Trajectory changed. Recalculating. I'll be back on route.
